name: Gakkou de Atta Kowai Hanashi
source: Sakagami Shuuichi, a member of the school newspaper, is asked to gather information about the school's seven mysteries. He meets with six other students after school to listen to their stories.
translation: 学校新闻部成员坂上修一受托搜集学校七大不可思议的资料。放学后，他与另外六名学生见面，聆听他们讲述各自的故事。
